ps.en: Exceeding initial [[expectations|expectation]], scholars with deep research [[experience]] conducted a groundbreaking [[experiment]]. They consulted a leading [[expert]] who shared her vast [[expertise]] before the patent was set to [[expire]].
ps.zh: 超出最初的预期，拥有深厚研究经验的学者们进行了一项突破性的实验。他们咨询了一位顶尖专家，在专利即将到期前分享了她的广博专业知识。

ps.en: Relying on natural [[instinct]], directors established a research [[institute]] as a formal [[institution]]. To protecting asset value, they applied for financial [[insurance]] to [[insure]] against market risks.
ps.zh: 依靠直觉，管理者们建立了一家研究机构作为正式制度。为了保护资产价值，他们申请了金融保险，以投保应对市场风险。

ps.en: Maintaining [[integral]] safety rules allowed engineers to [[integrate]] AI modules while upholding moral [[integrity]]. Driven by [[curious]] inquiries, student [[curiosity]] focused on how global [[currency]] reflects the [[current]] economic state.
ps.zh: 维持完整的安全规则让工程师们在维护道德诚信的同时得以整合人工智能模块。在好奇探究的驱动下，学生的好奇心集中在全球货币如何反映当前经济状况上。

ps.en: To [[cut]] operational expenses and manage [[cumulative]] debt, financial analysts computed the [[average]] profit. They advised executives to [[avoid]] hasty choices, stay [[awake]] during crisis, and [[award]] resilient teams, making every leader [[aware]] of potential challenges.
ps.zh: 为了削减运营费用并管理累积债务，金融分析师计算了平均利润。他们建议高管避免草率决定，在危机期间保持清醒，并奖励有韧性的团队，使每位领导者都意识到潜在的挑战。

ps.en: Handling an [[awkward]] negotiation, diplomats avoided [[extravagant]] claims under [[extreme]] pressure. Although the underlying danger remained [[invisible]], they sought to [[invoke]] treaty terms that would [[involve]] all member states in resolving a contentious [[issue]] over a single budget [[item]].
ps.zh: 在处理一场尴尬的谈判时，外交官们在极度压力下避免了奢华不实的主张。尽管潜在的危险依然隐形，他们试图援引条约条款，让所有成员国都参与解决围绕单一预算项目的有争议议题。

ps.en: Legal advisors warned that bad decisions could [[overturn]] court rulings and [[overwhelm]] local institutions.
ps.zh: 法律顾问警告说，糟糕的决定可能会推翻法院裁决并压垮当地机构。

ps.en: Investors agreed to [[purchase]] new equipment to [[pursue]] sustainable growth. In their relentless [[pursuit]] of truth, researchers solved a complex [[puzzle]], opting to [[reverse]] outdated procedures and [[review]] recent test results.
ps.zh: 投资者同意购买新设备以追求可持续增长。在对真理的不懈追求中，研究人员解开了一个复杂的谜团，选择颠倒过时的程序并审查最近的测试结果。

ps.en: Specialists met to [[revise]] regulatory guidelines and [[revive]] local commerce. Giving a substantial [[reward]] to innovative talent enriched [[rich]] communities, causing profit to [[rise]] without increasing systemic [[risk]].
ps.zh: 专家们开会修改监管指南并复苏当地商业。给予创新人才实质性奖励丰富了富裕社区，在不增加系统性风险的情况下促进了利润增长。

ps.en: Facing a tough [[rival|riva]], each contestant embraced their unique [[role]]. They decided to [[roll]] out fresh strategies, trace the root cause to its [[root]], plan a clear [[route]], and establish a steady [[routine]].
ps.zh: 面对强劲的对手，每位参赛者都拥抱了自己独特的角色。他们决定推出全新的策略，将根本原因追溯至根源，规划一条清晰的路线，并建立稳定的日常惯例。

c: live up to expectations 达到期望
words.dif: expectation 指对未来事物发生的预料期待或期望。
words.pat: The new product line exceeded all financial expectations.
words.patZh: 新产品线超出了所有财务预期。

words.dif: experience 作不可数名词指经验，作可数名词指个人经历。
words.pat: Hands-on work experience is invaluable for career advancement.
words.patZh: 亲身体验的工作经验对职业提升宝贵无比。

words.dif: experiment 侧重为检验某种假设科学理论而进行的试验操作。
words.pat: Researchers performed a controlled experiment to test the hypothesis.
words.patZh: 研究人员进行了一项对照实验来检验该假设。

words.exam: 专家；能手；熟练的；专家的
words.dif: expert 指在特定专业领域具有深厚知识和技能的人士。
words.pat: The court summoned an expert witness to evaluate the technical report.
words.patZh: 法院传唤了一位专家证人来评估该技术报告。

words.dif: expertise 指在某领域长期积累的深厚专门技能与知识。
words.pat: Her technical expertise proved vital during the software overhaul.
words.patZh: 在软件彻底改造期间，她的技术专长被证明至关重要。

words.dif: expire 指协议、证件、期限届满失效。
words.pat: Check your passport validity before booking international flights as it may expire.
words.patZh: 在预订国际航班前检查护照有效期，因为护照可能会到期。

words.dif: instinct 指与生俱来的本能反应或无须理性推理的直觉。
words.pat: Animals rely on natural instinct to navigate long migrations.
words.patZh: 动物依靠天然本能来进行长途迁徙。

c: institute legal action 发起诉讼
words.dif: institute 作名词指专门的科研教育机构，作动词指建立实施规章。
words.pat: The medical institute announced a breakthrough in cancer research.
words.patZh: 该医疗研究所宣布了癌症研究方面的突破。

words.dif: institution 指社会公共机构、知名大学，或长久确立的社会制度。
words.pat: Trust in public institutions remains vital for democratic stability.
words.patZh: 对公共机构的信任对于民主稳定依然至关重要。

words.dif: insurance 特指支付保费以防范风险损失的商业保险体系。
words.pat: Comprehensive health insurance covers emergency hospital visits.
words.patZh: 综合健康保险涵盖紧急住院费用。

c: insure against loss 为…投保防范损失
words.dif: insure 特指向保险公司购买保费投保。
words.pat: Homeowners should insure their properties against flood and fire damage.
words.patZh: 业主应当为其财产投保以防范洪水和火灾损失。

words.exam: 构成整体所必需的；不可或缺的；完整的
c: integral part 不可或缺的部分
words.dif: integral 强调作为整体不可分割的有机组成部分。
words.pat: Teamwork is an integral element of our corporate culture.
words.patZh: 团队合作是公司文化中不可或缺的要素。

words.exam: 使合并；使成为一体；整合
words.dif: integrate 侧重将不同部分有机结合融为一体。
words.pat: The new software allows users to integrate cloud services seamlessly.
words.patZh: 新软件允许用户无缝整合云服务。

words.dif: integrity 侧重坚守道德操守的正直诚信，或结构的完整性。
words.pat: Leaders must act with high moral integrity to gain public trust.
words.patZh: 领导者必须以高度的道德诚信行事以赢得公众信任。

c: be curious about 对…感到好奇
words.dif: curious 指对新事物充满强烈求知欲望或事物奇特。
words.pat: Children are naturally curious about the mysteries of the natural world.
words.patZh: 孩子们对自然界的奥秘天然感到好奇。

words.exam: 好奇心；求知欲；奇珍异宝
c: out of curiosity 出于好奇
words.dif: curiosity 指强烈的求知探究心理，或罕见奇特之物。
words.pat: Out of curiosity, she opened the old leather-bound journal.
words.patZh: 出于好奇，她打开了那本精装旧皮质日记。

words.dif: currency 指流通的国家法定货币，或概念的普遍流行。
words.pat: Fluctuations in foreign currency exchange rates affect international trade.
words.patZh: 外币汇率的波动会影响国际贸易。

words.exam: 当前的；通行的；水流；电流；趋势
words.dif: current 作形容词指当前的，作名词指水流、电流或思潮。
words.pat: Under current regulations, all safety tests must be documented.
words.patZh: 在当前规定下，所有安全测试都必须予以记录。

words.dif: cut 可指物理上的切割切开，也可指大幅削减预算费用。
words.pat: The board decided to cut operational spending to preserve cash reserves.
words.patZh: 董事会决定削减运营支出以保留现金储备。

words.dif: cumulative 强调随着时间连续不断叠加积累而成的。
words.pat: The cumulative impact of long-term stress can damage physical health.
words.patZh: 长期压力的累积影响会损害身体健康。

words.exam: 平均的；普通的；平均数；平均为
c: above average 高于平均水平
words.dif: average 指数学上的算术平均数，或一般的、普通的。
words.pat: On average, employees work forty hours per week in this company.
words.patZh: 平均而言，这家公司的员工每周工作四十个小时。

words.dif: avoid 侧重采取措施防止不愉快或危险的事情发生。
words.pat: Drivers should slow down in bad weather to avoid accidents.
words.patZh: 驾驶员在恶劣天气下应当减速以避免事故。

words.exam: 醒着的；警觉的；唤醒；意识到
words.dif: awake 侧重处于非睡眠的清醒状态或对风险警觉。
words.pat: She lay awake listening to the heavy rain falling on the roof.
words.patZh: 她躺着清醒地听着倾盆大雨敲打屋顶。

c: award a contract 授予合同
words.dif: award 侧重经正式评判授予奖项、荣誉或判定赔偿。
words.pat: The jury decided to award the young scientist a research grant.
words.patZh: 评审团决定向这位年轻科学家授予一项研究资助。

c: environmentally aware 具环保意识的
words.dif: aware 强调通过感知、察觉而对某情况有清楚了解。
words.pat: Consumers are increasingly aware of the health risks of sugar.
words.patZh: 消费者越来越意识到糖的健康风险。

words.exam: 笨拙的；尴尬的；难处理的
c: awkward situation 难处理的局势
words.dif: awkward 指动作笨拙、局面尴尬或问题棘手难办。
words.pat: There was an awkward silence when the embarrassing mistake was revealed.
words.patZh: 当令人尴尬的错误被揭露时，现场出现了一片尴尬的沉默。

c: extravagant lifestyle 奢侈的生活方式
words.dif: extravagant 指超出合理限度的挥霍、奢华或过分评价。
words.pat: The CEO was criticized for his extravagant spending on private jets.
words.patZh: 首席执行官因在私人飞机上的奢华花费而受到批评。

words.dif: extreme 指程度达到最高极限或处在最边缘末端。
words.pat: Mountaineers face extreme cold and severe oxygen deprivation on high peaks.
words.patZh: 登山者在高峰上面对极度严寒和严重缺氧。

words.dif: invisible 指肉眼无法看见或在经济社会中无形存在的。
words.pat: Microscopic bacteria are invisible to the naked eye.
words.patZh: 微小的细菌用肉眼是看不见的。

c: invoke a clause 援引条款
invoke a law 引用法律
words.dif: invoke 侧重在辩论或法律诉讼中援引法规或祈求神灵。
words.pat: The defense attorney chose to invoke constitutional rights during trial.
words.patZh: 辩护律师选择在审判期间援引宪法权利。

words.dif: involve 侧重作为必要部分包含其中，或使人卷入参与。
words.pat: Implementing the new policy will involve collaboration among multiple departments.
words.patZh: 实施新政策将需要多个部门之间的协作。

c: issue a statement 发表声明
words.dif: issue 侧重引起讨论辩论的核心争议焦点，或官方发行证书。
words.pat: Climate change has become a crucial political issue worldwide.
words.patZh: 气候变化已成为全球范围内一个关键的政治议题。

c: item of news 一条新闻
words.dif: item 指清单列表中的单一条目、具体单件物品。
words.pat: The committee reviewed each item on the meeting agenda carefully.
words.patZh: 委员会仔细审查了会议议程上的每一项。

c: overturn a decision 推翻决定
words.dif: overturn 指物理上的翻倒，或法律判决主张被正式撤销推翻。
words.pat: The supreme court voted to overturn the lower court's ruling.
words.patZh: 最高法院投票决定推翻下级法院的裁决。

c: overwhelm the defense 冲垮防御
words.dif: overwhelm 指在力量、数量或情绪上压倒压垮对方。
words.pat: The sudden surge of online orders threatened to overwhelm the warehouse.
words.patZh: 线上订单的突然激增可能会压垮仓库。

c: make a purchase 开展采购
words.dif: purchase 比 buy 更正式，常用于商业交易采购。
words.pat: The agency approved funds to purchase advanced medical equipment.
words.patZh: 该机构批准资金采购先进的医疗设备。

c: pursue a goal 追求目标
pursue a career 从事职业
words.dif: pursue 侧重持续不懈地追赶目标、理想或事业。
words.pat: She decided to move abroad to pursue higher academic qualifications.
words.patZh: 她决定出国以追求更高的学术学历。

words.dif: pursuit 指追求目标的过程，或业余爱好的活动。
words.pat: The endless pursuit of knowledge drives scientific advancement.
words.patZh: 对知识的无止境追求推动着科学进步。

c: solve a puzzle 解开谜团
words.dif: puzzle 指令人百思不得其解的谜团，或使人感到困惑。
words.pat: His mysterious disappearance remains an unsolved puzzle for detectives.
words.patZh: 他的神秘失踪对于侦探来说依然是一个未解之谜。

words.exam: 颠倒；彻底改变；相反的；背面
c: reverse the trend 扭转趋势
words.dif: reverse 指方向、顺序或政策彻底向相反方向转变。
words.pat: The new manager hopes to reverse the company's declining sales.
words.patZh: 新经理希望扭转公司销售额下滑的趋势。

words.dif: review 侧重正式的复查、评估审查或书刊剧评。
words.pat: The committee will review all job applications by the end of the week.
words.patZh: 委员会将在本周末前审查所有求职申请。

c: revise a draft 修改草案
revise a plan 修订计划
words.dif: revise 指对书稿、法律条款或计划进行改动修订。
words.pat: The author had to revise the manuscript based on editors' feedback.
words.patZh: 作者不得不根据编辑的反馈修改手稿。

c: revive the economy 复苏经济
revive interest 重新激发兴趣
words.dif: revive 指使处于衰落、濒死状态的事物重新恢复生机。
words.pat: Tax incentives helped revive local businesses after the recession.
words.patZh: 税收优惠有助于在衰退后复苏当地商业。

words.dif: reward 侧重对付出辛劳、善行给与的报答酬谢。
words.pat: Hard work and dedication will eventually bring a rich reward.
words.patZh: 努力工作和奉献精神最终会带来丰厚的回报。

c: rich in resources 资源丰富
words.dif: rich 指财产富裕、资源丰富或色彩风味浓郁。
words.pat: The region is rich in mineral deposits and natural resources.
words.patZh: 该地区矿藏和自然资源丰富。

c: rise in price 价格上涨
rise to power 步入权力中心
words.dif: rise 为不及物动词，指自动上升、升起或提高。
words.pat: Temperatures are expected to rise rapidly during the weekend.
words.patZh: 预计周末气温将迅速上升。

words.dif: risk 指可能遭受损失伤害的不确定危险风险。
words.pat: Investing in early-stage startups involves a high level of risk.
words.patZh: 投资早期初创公司涉及高水平的风险。

words.exam: 竞争者；对手；与…媲美；竞争的
c: rival firm 竞争对手公司
words.dif: rival 指在同一领域相互竞争对抗的对手。
words.pat: The two tech companies have been fierce rivals for over a decade.
words.patZh: 这两家科技公司十多年来一直是激烈的对手。

c: play a key role 发挥关键作用
words.dif: role 指戏剧中扮演的角色，或在活动中发挥的作用职责。
words.pat: Education plays a critical role in shaping a society's future.
words.patZh: 教育在塑造社会未来方面发挥着关键作用。

words.dif: roll 指物体在平面上滚动转动，或卷状物、名册。
words.pat: The tech company plans to roll out new software updates next month.
words.patZh: 该科技公司计划下个月推出新的软件更新。

words.dif: root 指植物的根系，或事物发展的根本源头。
words.pat: Investigators sought to uncover the root cause of the system failure.
words.patZh: 调查人员试图揭示系统故障的根本原因。

words.dif: route 指从起点到终点的具体行驶或传输路线。
words.pat: The delivery truck followed a designated route through the city.
words.patZh: 快递卡车沿着穿过城市的指定路线行驶。

words.exam: 例行公事；日常惯例；例行的；常规的
words.dif: routine 指习惯性经常进行的例行工作事务。
words.pat: Following a healthy daily routine improves energy levels and focus.
words.patZh: 遵循健康的日常惯例可以提高精力水平和专注力。
